title: Turned Down by Banks, Kiro'o Games Sold Shares to Finish Aurion
conflicts: Funding figures differ by date and source: €122,000 of €180,000 (Madiba, January 2015), 120 million CFA francs or over €182,500 at close (Jeune Afrique, April 2015), about $270,000 shares plus Kickstarter (WSJ 2016); Kickstarter €49,774 or €49,775 versus 'over $50,000'. The story gives the dated euro figures and 'just short of €50,000'. Later totals ($900,000 from 800 micro-investors, PocketGamer 2025) cover later rounds and are attributed. Staff 18 (CNN, WSJ 2016) versus about 20 (2015 reports); 18 used at release.
notes: Slate said 2016 crowdfunding and bootstrapped; the documented decision is the May 2013 choice to sell shares after banks refused, so the episode runs from May 2013 to the April 2016 release, and funding is recorded as mixed (equity crowdfunding plus Kickstarter). Kickstarter and WSJ pages are blocked for the verifier; Kushner's WSJ article is cited from his Substack reprint. Quote stance: complicates.
